# Benchmark route: default character, largest 3D view, turn right on the spot forever.
# W entries wait on game state (the button under the pointer is live), so the route does not
# depend on how long loading takes.  View size starts at medium and cycles small -> large ->
# medium per click on its icon; the setting is not saved.
1    51 174 W     # start screen: green (character) button, id 1
10   51 174 L     # -> save-slot screen
10   132 175 W    # right die, id 10
10   132 175 L    # cancel -> the game starts with the default character
0    15 188 W     # in game: computer button live
80   15 188 L     # options dialog
150  193 52 -     # view-size icon (second from the right, top row)
80   193 52 L     # medium -> small
80   193 52 -
80   193 52 L     # small -> large
50   160 90 -
80   160 90 L     # click outside the dialog applies it
# The townsman walks up and greets the player at a machine-dependent time (soon after the
# start on a 68020, often not at all on the A500).  His speech blocks the game until EXIT in the
# conversation panel (polled by h2, invisible to W).  Stand and click EXIT every 100 fields for
# 1500 fields, on every machine; with no conversation the click lands on the status bar.
